name: Wiggle Wiggle Bush
source:
Help Wiggle find their way past the big scary COLOSSALLY big Monster blocking their path!

But Wiggle knows the best way to clear the path, with of course, poetry!

Go through classic poems, according to Wiggle, as Wiggle does their best to remember, and help fill in those blanks.

[From [url=https://cedesdc.itch.io/wiggle-wiggle-bush]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
帮助Wiggle找到路，越过阻挡他们道路的巨大可怕怪物！

但Wiggle知道扫清道路的最佳方法，当然是诗歌！

根据威格尔的说法，温格尔会尽力记住经典诗歌，并帮助填补这些空白。

[来自[url=https://cedesdc.itch.io/wiggle-wiggle-bush]itch.io[/url]]
